events.when: Mon-Sat through Nov 24 · mostly 2 PM to 6 PM, 2 PM to 5 PM from Nov 16
events.summary: Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. events.title: Frank Brown International Songwriters' Festival
events.when: Thu 11/5 to Sun 11/15 · times vary by stage
events.venue: Flora-Bama Lounge and more than two dozen stages along the Gulf Coast
events.address: 17401 Perdido Key Dr, Perdido Key, FL 32507
events.summary: More than 200 songwriters play over 600 performances on more than two dozen stages along the Florida and Alabama Gulf Coast during this 11-day festival, which grew out of the Flora-Bama on Perdido Key. Songwriters tell the stories behind their songs, from Grammy winners to rising talent. Many shows are free, and some are ticketed or charge a cover.

events.title: Guys and Dolls at Stage Crafters
events.when: Fri 11/6 to Sun 11/15 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM
events.address: 109 Miracle Strip Pkwy SW, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548
events.summary: Stage Crafters stages the Damon Runyon musical comedy Guys and Dolls over two weekends in November. events.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile
events.when: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027
events.summary: The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

events.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment)
events.when: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM
events.summary: Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

events.summary: D&D Encounters and the RPG Meet-N-Greet are Wednesday role-playing nights at GameMasters Guild in Crestview.
